description: Uranus and Neptune, 1781-1850: REBOUND IAS15, Sun and eight planets from JPL Horizons states at Herschel's discovery (1781-03-13.0 TDB), run with Neptune's mass (run 1) and with Neptune's mass set to zero (run 2, Neptune a test particle). Positions heliocentric; the no-Neptune Uranus is stored as an offset from run 1.

integrator.units: AU, day, M_sun; G = k^2 (Gaussian k = 0.01720209895)
integrator.frame: centre of mass (sim.move_to_com) after adding heliocentric states

bodies.name: sun
bodies.source: 1 M_sun by definition; inner planets are explicit bodies

bodies.name: mercury
bodies.source: IAU 2009 system of astronomical constants, Sun/planet mass ratio (fork.model.bodies)

bodies.name: venus
bodies.source: IAU 2009 system of astronomical constants, Sun/planet mass ratio (fork.model.bodies)

bodies.name: earth_moon
bodies.source: IAU 2009 system of astronomical constants, Sun/planet mass ratio (fork.model.bodies)

bodies.name: mars
bodies.source: IAU 2009 system of astronomical constants, Sun/planet mass ratio (fork.model.bodies)

bodies.name: jupiter
bodies.source: IAU 2009 system of astronomical constants, Sun/planet mass ratio (fork.model.bodies)

bodies.name: saturn
bodies.source: IAU 2009 system of astronomical constants, Sun/planet mass ratio (fork.model.bodies)

bodies.name: uranus
bodies.source: IAU 2009 system of astronomical constants, Sun/planet mass ratio (fork.model.bodies)

bodies.name: neptune
bodies.source: IAU 2009 system of astronomical constants, Sun/planet mass ratio (fork.model.bodies)

frame: heliocentric, ecliptic and mean equinox of J2000; longitudes for the conjunction precessed to ecliptic of date
offset_exaggeration_rule: smallest K in {1, 2, 5} x 10^k with 0.8 <= K * max |(dx, dy)| <= 2 AU

conjunction.definition: heliocentric Uranus-Neptune conjunction from run 1: first epoch 1810-1835 where Uranus overtakes Neptune in ecliptic-of-date longitude, as in docs/notes/scripts/m6c_conjunction.py

grid_10_day.grid: 1810-01-01.0 to 1835-01-01.0 TDB, every 10 d, linear interpolation

grid_1_day.grid: 1810-01-01.0 to 1835-01-01.0 TDB, every 1 d, linear interpolation

jpl.source: site/data/m6c_conjunction.json epoch.jpl_uranus_neptune_conjunction_jd_tdb (Horizons, inner barycentre, 10-day grid, rounded to 0.1 d)

along_track_sign_change.method: along_track on the 1-day 1810-1835 grid (run 1), + to - crossing nearest the 1-day-grid conjunction, linear interpolation

validation.method: run 1 integrated to each cached Horizons epoch exactly (no interpolation); angle between heliocentric position vectors

uranus.note: no cached epoch reaches J1850.0; latest is 1846-01-01 00:00 TDB

neptune.note: no cached epoch reaches J1850.0; latest is 1849-10-01 19:58 TDB

fields.uranus_no_neptune_dx, uranus_no_neptune_: run 2 Uranus minus run 1 Uranus, AU (draw at offset_exaggeration times)
fields.dlon_arcsec: Uranus heliocentric ecliptic-J2000 longitude, run 1 minus run 2
fields.accel_along_track: Neptune's heliocentric perturbing acceleration on Uranus (direct + indirect), component along Uranus's heliocentric velocity, AU/day^2; + = drawn ahead, - = held back
fields.accel_radial: same, component along Uranus's heliocentric position (+ = outward)
